title: Database Connection Pool Recovery & Scaling
description: Procedure for diagnosing and resolving database connection pool exhaustion, thread locks, and connection leakage.
prerequisites: Read access to DB connection telemetry and authorization to trigger service restarts or scale pool limits.
steps:
1. Run check_database_connections() to inspect active vs max allowed pool connections.
2. Run get_logs(service='payment-api', lines=50) to verify queue pool timeout error signatures.
3. Verify if backend DB instance CPU and memory are within healthy thresholds (<80%).
4. If DB is healthy but connection pool is locked, trigger restart_service(service='payment-api') to drop orphaned connections.
5. Run verify_resolution(service='payment-api') and inspect error rate drop below 1%.
6. If high load persists, increment pool overflow allocation to 50 connections.
rollback_instructions: If restart fails to initialize new pool connections, execute rollback_deployment to previous stable version and restart DB connection proxy.
verification_steps: Check service health endpoint GET /health, verify DB pool active connections < 60%, and observe payment error rate < 0.5% for 3 minutes.

title: Auth Service JWKS Cache Invalidation & Rolling Restart
description: Standard operational steps when JWT validation fails due to key rotation desync, cache invalidation delays, or expired crypto keys.
prerequisites: Access to auth-service management endpoints and Redis cluster CLI.
steps:
1. Run check_service_health('auth-service') to confirm 401 error spike.
2. Inspect logs for 'Signature verification failed' or 'JWKS key not found'.
3. Execute JWKS redis cache purge command.
4. Trigger restart_service('auth-service') to force fresh public key fetching.
5. Run verify_resolution('auth-service') by executing sample token introspection.
rollback_instructions: Revert active JWKS public key ID in Secret Manager to previous key version and restart auth pods.
verification_steps: Confirm token verification success rate > 99.9% and response latency < 40ms.

title: Emergency Deployment Rollback & Canary Drain
description: Comprehensive guide for rolling back failed application deployments, bad migrations, or crash-looping container versions.
prerequisites: Service name and target previous stable version identifier.
steps:
1. Run check_deployment(service) to verify current deployed release tag and crash count.
2. Run get_logs(service) to capture error trace and failure mode.
3. Request human approval for rollback_deployment(service, target_version).
4. Execute rollback_deployment tool.
5. Run verify_resolution(service) to monitor pod readiness probe and error metric stabilization.
rollback_instructions: If rollback encounters database schema mismatch, execute down-migration script before proceeding with container rollback.
verification_steps: Ensure 100% of replicas report HEALTHY status and HTTP 5xx error rate is 0%.

title: PostgreSQL Lock Contention & Deadlock Remediation
description: Mitigating catastrophic row locks, transaction deadlocks, and hung analytical queries blocking transactional pipelines.
prerequisites: DB admin credentials to query pg_stat_activity and invoke pg_terminate_backend.
steps:
1. Run check_database_connections('database-service') to detect blocked query queues.
2. Run get_logs('database-service') to isolate blocking query PIDs and table lock names.
3. Terminate non-critical long-running queries holding exclusive row locks.
4. If deadlocks originate from application race condition, request service restart of culprit microservice.
5. Run verify_resolution('database-service') and confirm lock latency < 10ms.
rollback_instructions: Re-enable autovacuum daemon and resume paused batch workers once transaction throughput stabilizes.
verification_steps: Ensure pg_stat_activity shows zero queries waiting on locks > 2000ms.

title: Redis Memory Pressure & Session Cache Flushing
description: Managing Redis maxmemory eviction storms, memory leaks, and cascading database load due to cache thundering herds.
prerequisites: Redis telemetry access and permission to flush non-critical cache namespaces.
steps:
1. Run get_metrics('user-service') and observe memory utilization and cache hit ratio.
2. Identify if memory is exhausted due to missing key TTLs.
3. Flush expired or orphaned cache keys via selective namespace eviction.
4. Trigger restart_service('user-service') to reset application cache client pools.
5. Run verify_resolution('user-service') to confirm database CPU normalization.
rollback_instructions: If session data was stored without persistent fallback, restore Redis snapshot from latest automated RDB backup.
verification_steps: Verify Redis used memory < 75% and cache hit ratio > 92%.

title: Payment Webhook Queue Processing & Gateway Decoupling
description: Resolving synchronous webhook timeouts, gateway 504s, and backlog accumulation from third-party payment providers.
prerequisites: Payment gateway dashboard access and message queue admin permissions.
steps:
1. Inspect get_logs('payment-api') for upstream 504 gateway timeout signatures.
2. Check webhook queue depth and worker consumer health.
3. Restart payment webhook worker instances to unblock stuck worker threads.
4. Run verify_resolution('payment-api') and observe webhook ACK latency < 100ms.
rollback_instructions: Disable async ingestion feature flag if message broker experiences delivery failures.
verification_steps: Confirm payment webhook processing queue depth is decreasing toward 0.

title: Auth Rate Limiter Proxy Header Trust Configuration
description: Fixing global rate limiting false-positives caused by reverse proxy / CDN header misconfigurations.
prerequisites: Configuration repository access and ingress controller access.
steps:
1. Check get_logs('auth-service') for 429 status codes originating from single proxy IP.
2. Verify CF-Connecting-IP / X-Forwarded-For header parsing in auth service middleware.
3. Apply corrected trusted proxy CIDR block configuration.
4. Execute restart_service('auth-service') to load updated proxy configuration.
5. Run verify_resolution('auth-service') and verify login success rate.
rollback_instructions: Revert proxy header trust configuration to fallback IP list.
verification_steps: Confirm 429 rate limit errors for legitimate users drop to 0%.

title: Kafka Consumer Group Rebalance Storm Stabilization
description: Remediating consumer lag, heartbeat timeouts, and continuous partition rebalancing in distributed message pipelines.
prerequisites: Kafka cluster metrics and consumer group lag monitoring access.
steps:
1. Check consumer lag across partition topics.
2. Verify max.poll.interval.ms against maximum batch processing duration.
3. Restart order-service consumer group pods in rolling order.
4. Run verify_resolution('order-service') and monitor queue drain rate.
rollback_instructions: Revert consumer partition count or batch size if broker load spikes.
verification_steps: Ensure consumer group state is 'Stable' and lag metric is declining.

title: Database WAL Storage Exhaustion Emergency Recovery
description: Emergency recovery when database disk space is exhausted by unarchived WAL logs or runaway table growth.
prerequisites: Root access to database storage volume and backup archiver status.
steps:
1. Check disk utilization and WAL directory byte count.
2. Restart hung WAL archiving background worker.
3. Purge verified archived WAL segments to recover disk headspace.
4. Run verify_resolution('database-service') to confirm DB transitions from read-only to read-write mode.
rollback_instructions: Attach emergency auxiliary EBS storage volume if WAL archiving cannot keep pace with transaction writes.
verification_steps: Database responds to INSERT/UPDATE transactions with latency < 20ms.

title: Payment API TLS Certificate & CA Trust Store Refresh
description: Resolving outbound HTTPS SSL handshake failures, certificate expirations, and CA trust bundle mismatches.
prerequisites: Access to update base container certificates or deploy patched container image.
steps:
1. Run get_logs('payment-api') to confirm CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED error trace.
2. Deploy updated CA certificates bundle.
3. Execute restart_service('payment-api') to reload system trust store.
4. Run verify_resolution('payment-api') and confirm outbound gateway requests succeed with 200 OK.
rollback_instructions: Revert to pinned legacy certificate if upstream gateway has not migrated.
verification_steps: Verify zero SSL handshake errors in payment-api telemetry for 5 minutes.

title: Distributed Lock Lease & Concurrency Contention Fix
description: Diagnosing and fixing race conditions, double fulfillment, and distributed lock timeout expirations.
prerequisites: Access to distributed lock provider (Redis/Consul/Zookeeper) and order worker controls.
steps:
1. Check lock lease TTL vs downstream fulfillment latency.
2. Increase lock TTL and enable background heartbeat renewal thread.
3. Restart order-service worker pods.
4. Run verify_resolution('order-service') and confirm idempotency guarantee.
rollback_instructions: Revert lock configuration parameters to default and enable manual deduplication queue.
verification_steps: Confirm duplicate order processing rate is exactly 0%.

title: User Service GraphQL Query Complexity Throttling
description: Applying query depth limits, cost analysis, and CPU throttling for heavy GraphQL operations.
steps:
1. Inspect CPU load across user-service pods.
2. Enable query depth limit rule (max depth = 5) in gateway config.
3. Restart user-service pods to reload schema rules.
4. Run verify_resolution('user-service') and confirm pod CPU stabilizes below 30%.
rollback_instructions: Disable query complexity filter if critical mobile clients fail complex composite queries.
verification_steps: Check average GraphQL response latency < 80ms and CPU usage < 35%.

title: Payment Circuit Breaker Manual Reset & Probe
description: Manually resetting stuck circuit breakers following upstream third-party recovery.
prerequisites: Admin access to payment-api circuit breaker dashboard or Redis state key.
steps:
1. Verify upstream banking API status is operational.
2. Clear circuit breaker OPEN state key in Redis.
3. Trigger restart_service('payment-api') to initialize circuit breaker in CLOSED state.
4. Run verify_resolution('payment-api') and confirm transaction pass rate > 99%.
rollback_instructions: Re-trip circuit breaker manually if upstream partner starts returning 5xx errors again.
verification_steps: Confirm successful test payment authorization with HTTP 200 response.
